summary.text: Creigh Deeds is a Democratic member of the Senate of Virginia for District 11, serving since 2001. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Commerce and Labor (chair), Courts of Justice, and Finance and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: R. Creigh Deeds was born in Richmond, Virginia, on January 4, 1958, according to the Senate's member page.
The page says he earned a B.A. from Concord College in 1980 and a J.D. from Wake Forest University School of Law in 1984, and lists his occupation as attorney.
The page lists him as a member of the House from 1992 to 2001 and a member of the Senate since 2001.
It shows him as chair of the Commerce and Labor Committee, with seats on Courts of Justice, Finance and Appropriations, Privileges and Elections, and Rules.
